prompt.project_info: A bright minimalist city fashion walk with light fabric movement and a candid late-morning Manhattan atmosphere.
prompt.main_subject: An adult blonde woman with soft golden hair, neutral makeup, and a serene expression, walking mid-stride in a cream ribbed short-sleeve knit top, a flowing ivory midi skirt with opaque lining, and simple unbranded light sandals.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-length vertical street portrait with a classic New York stone-building backdrop, fire escapes, blurred taxis and pedestrians in the distance, and sunlit concrete. Keep the subject sharp and the city softly in motion; no readable storefront text, vehicle branding, or logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Sunny late-morning summer light at approximately 5200K, soft shadows on concrete, gentle breeze moving hair and skirt, realistic fabric texture, natural skin variation, and restrained neutral color.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/1.8 and ISO 100, vertical 3:4 crop, sharp subject focus, subtle background motion blur, filmic highlight roll-off, gentle grain, and natural vignette.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Adult blonde woman with soft golden hair walking mid-stride through a New York City street with stone buildings, fire escapes, blurred yellow taxis, and distant pedestrians. She wears an elegant cream ribbed short-sleeve knit top, a flowing ivory midi skirt with opaque lining, simple unbranded light sandals, and minimal jewelry. Sunny late-morning summer light, soft shadows on concrete, a breeze moving fabric and hair, candid unposed street-style moment, serene expression, realistic skin and fabric textures, cinematic fashion editorial composition, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, vertical framing, no readable text, vehicle branding, or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed anatomy
